commands.name: auth
set

arguments.name: COOKIE
arguments.description: Session cookie for the availability API as  "name=value" (copy it from your browser's DevTools).

commands.description: Store the session cookie ("name=value")  copied from your browser's DevTools.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show auth cookie status (never prints the value).
Manage the session cookie used to authenticate against the availability API.

commands.name: availability

options.name: --model
options.description: Model(s) to check. Repeatable or comma-separated.  Overrides the preset.

options.name: --preset
options.description: Preset supplying default regions, models, and Learn  tab. Defaults to the active preset.

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Bypass caches and retrieve fresh PTU and PAYG data.

options.name: --region
options.description: Region(s) to check. Repeatable or comma-separated.  Overrides the preset.

options.name: --tab
options.description: Microsoft Learn PAYG geography: az-americas,  az-europe, az-apac, or az-mea. Overrides the preset.

options.name: --type
options.description: PTU and PAYG Standard type(s) to show: datazone,  regional, or global. Defaults to datazone.

commands.description: Show PTU and PAYG Standard availability for regions and  models (data zone by default).

commands.name: endpoint

arguments.name: URL
arguments.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the availability API  endpoint.

commands.name: show
commands.description: Show the configured availability API endpoint.
Show or update the availability API endpoint.

commands.name: preset
remove
commands.description: Remove a preset (the 'default' preset is  protected).

commands.name: reset

options.name: --all
options.description: Also remove every preset other than  'default'.

commands.description: Restore the 'default' preset to factory  values and make it active.

commands.name: set

options.name: --models
options.description: Model list. Repeatable or comma-separated. When  creating a preset without models, factory defaults are used.

options.name: --regions
options.description: Region list. Repeatable or comma-separated. When  creating a preset without regions, factory defaults are used.

options.name: --tab
options.description: Microsoft Learn PAYG geography: az-americas,  az-europe, az-apac, or az-mea. New presets default to az-europe.

options.name: --types
options.description: PTU and PAYG Standard type(s): datazone, regional, or global. Defaults to datazone.

commands.description: Create a preset or update its  regions/models/deployment types/PAYG geography.
examples: preset set eu --regions swedencentral,francecentral --models  gpt-4.1 --types datazone,global --tab az-europe

commands.name: show

arguments.name: NAME
arguments.description: Preset to show. Defaults to the active preset.

commands.description: Show a preset's regions, models, deployment  types, and PAYG geography.

commands.name: use
commands.description: Make a preset the active default.
Manage region/model/deployment-type/PAYG-geography presets and the active default.
